title: Site Control and Telemetry
description: Designs bounded industrial telemetry controllers with protected sensing and wired communications.
constraints: Partition noisy power and communications functions from sensitive acquisition paths.
Make external-port protection and grounding strategy reviewable.
Budget power, thermal load, interfaces, and processor resources before layout.
evidence_requirements: Official documentation for selected processing, power, protection, sensing, and communication functions.
Interface electrical limits and reference designs from authoritative sources.
Installed or provenance-checked KiCad symbol and footprint evidence.

verification: ERC and DRC findings are reported without concealment.
External interfaces, power domains, and grounding receive independent review.
Unsupported environmental or certification assumptions are identified.
acceptance.delivery_policy: Prefer complete editable output with visible design findings; stop early only when execution cannot produce structurally valid KiCad artifacts.
